chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Complete your rows when you see a gap, and it does not harm you to move back behind you, if you find tightness in the first row, to the row behind you, and to walk at an angle.

key_terms.خَلَلًا: A gap or deficiency in the row
key_terms.مُنْحَرِفًا: Moving sideways or at an angle

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if there is no space in the first row during congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs worshippers to maintain complete and orderly rows in congregational salat. It also permits a person to move backward to a row behind when the front row is too tight, even by walking at an angle, in order to preserve proper arrangement.
